mapper.sql: select id, race, name, description, leader, t_limit, capacity, start, end, r_rank, status, reason, is_deleted, create_time, update_time from team_info
mapper.select: SELECT ti.*, ui.id AS user_id, ui.name AS user_name, ui.college, ui.major, ui.number AS user_number, cm.name AS college_name, pm.name AS major_name, ti.name AS team_name, ri.name AS race_name, ui2.name AS leader_name, ui2.college AS leader_college, ui2.major AS leader_major, ui2.phone AS leader_phone, ui2.email AS leader_email, ui2.title AS leader_title, ui2.description AS leader_description FROM team_info ti LEFT JOIN user_info ui ON ti.leader = ui.id -- 队长的详细信息 LEFT JOIN t_college_major cm ON ui.college = cm.id AND cm.college = 0 -- 获取学院信息 LEFT JOIN t_college_major pm ON ui.major = pm.id AND pm.college != 0 -- 获取专业信息 LEFT JOIN race_info ri ON ti.race = ri.id -- 参加的比赛 LEFT JOIN user_info ui2 ON ti.leader = ui2.id -- 队长的详细信息 WHERE (ui.is_deleted = 0 OR ui.is_deleted IS NULL) -- 只查询未被删除的用户 AND (cm.is_deleted = 0 OR cm.is_deleted IS NULL) -- 只查询未被删除的学院 AND (pm.is_deleted = 0 OR pm.is_deleted IS NULL) -- 只查询未被删除的专业 and ti.race = #{race} and ti.name like concat('%', #{name}, '%') and ti.description like concat('%', #{description}, '%') and ti.leader = #{leader} and ti.t_limit like concat('%', #{tLimit}, '%') and ti.capacity = #{capacity} and ti.start = #{start} and ti.end = #{end} and ti.status = #{status} and ti.reason like concat('%', #{reason}, '%')
